hadur2.core.memory.Tiers.Move

Packages that use Tiers.Move
Package
Description
hadur2.core.adapt
Recognise, then adapt (S4): the opening book that turns a loaded profile into decisions for the first tick (ADAPT-1, ADAPT-2), the seeds it replays into the KNN views at a lower weight (ADAPT-3), and the trust that fades those seeds when the opponent no longer behaves like its profile (RES-4).
hadur2.core.memory
Opponent memory (stage S3): one OpponentProfile per opponent lineage, folded from each round's observations (MEM-2), encoded in a small checksummed binary format (ProfileCodec) and kept in a ProfileStore by the ProfileLibrary (MEM-1, MEM-3 to MEM-5, RES-3).

    static Tiers.Move
    Tiers.move(Estimate main, Estimate antiSurfer)
    As Tiers.move(OpponentProfile), from the main and anti-surfer ratings directly rather than a profile: GUN-4 reads the live, in-battle ratings this way, since a battle's own virtual guns have no profile to read them from.
    static Tiers.Move
    Tiers.move(OpponentProfile p)
    From our virtual guns' ratings: main at 25% or more is M0; both certainly under 10% is M3; the anti-surfer gun ahead of the main gun by more than the margin is M2; anything else M1.
